lines.en: : Wait! Stop.
: Why? Are you about to cum?
: No, I...thought I heard something.
: It’s probably just Noriko trying to sneak in like she always does. Don’t worry about it.
: I just don’t want you getting in trouble again...
: Nooooo, you just don’t want me getting grounded again because it means you won’t be able to come over and get jerked off every day.
: That’s just a more specific description of why I don’t want you getting in trouble.
: So you don’t care at all about me. You just like handjobs.
: You’d suffer too if you were grounded and you know it.
: Mhm...but we’ll be fine so long as we keep quiet.
: Easy for you to say when you already had your turn...
: You started it, not me. I’m just returning the favor right now.
She moves her hand faster. She’s been getting better at this lately. I just wish she’d stop staring into my eyes so much. It makes me uncomfortable.
: Seriously, you’re not about to cum are you? Because we agreed that-
: I already told you I’d warn you. Stop asking.
: I’m only asking because last time you randomly came all over the rug and I had to convince my mom it was just spilled milk.
: Well, there’s no use crying over that now, is there?
: You’re lucky I touch your dick at all, loser.
: I’d be luckier if...you actually let me finish.
: I knew it. You are about to cum.
: Can I just do it in your mouth?
: No...it tastes weird.
: Just go into the bathroom and do it yourself when you get close.
: You don’t have...tissues or anything?
: We could always, like...
: You know...
: If you still have any of those...things you stole from your brother...
: I don’t know, Niki...isn’t it still too soon for that?
: You’ve been saying that for over a year now. How long have we been friends exactly?
: Forever...basically.
: If you’re nervous, it’s okay. I am too. But it’s nothing to be embarrassed about. We can take it slow and-
: Stop.
: Akira, can we at least talk about-
: No, stop. I’m about to cum.
: Oh! Sorry.
: Does it hurt?...
: Not...really...
: But if you keep looking at me like that-
: Niki! Dinner’s almost ready! Is Akira eating with us again tonight?
: Nope! He’s going home! Thanks, Mom! Bye, Mom!
: Are you eating dinner with us tonight?
: Mhm! Be down soon! Thanks!
: Niki...why is the door locked? You know what we said about-
: Mom! I have a friend over! Can’t you wait until he’s gone?!
Niki rushes to the door and I seize the opportunity to quickly put my pants back on. That’s something I’ve been getting better at while she’s been busy training herself in the art of handjobs.
I’m getting better at controlling myself too. But that part’s the hardest since I’ve been trained up until now to let everything out on command.
: Sorry about that...Do you need to use the restroom?
: It’s fine. I can take care of it myself when I get home later. I have to leave soon anyway.
: Oh, right. Is Sekai still picking you up? What are you two doing so late anyway?
: Same as always, probably.
: More tutoring? Wouldn’t that make more sense during the day?
: Sure, if you want to start sacrificing our time together.
: On second thought, nighttime actually makes perfect sense. Forget I even said anything.
: Are you coming over tomorrow too? We’re going out for pizza. My parents will treat you again.
: I don’t know...I feel kind of bad about them feeding me so often. I can just eat something at home. But we can hang out until you have to leave.
: They really don’t mind, Akira. We normally bring home leftovers anyway.
: It’s fine, really. But tell them I said thanks for offering. Even if...you were the one sort of offering it on their behalf.
: Okay...
: And I know you already said no, but...are you sure you don’t want to come downstairs for dinner tonight? It’s beef stew. And you know how good my dad’s-
: Akira, that...woman is here to pick you up again.
: It’s his tutor, Mom! Why would you say it like that?
: Well, isn’t she his sister-in-law as well? I never know what to call that girl. Either way, she’s here.
: I’ll be down in a second. Thanks, Mrs. Nakayama.
: Kiss goodbye? Or hug goodbye? I...never really know what to do anymore.
: Just hug me, I guess. You kissed my penis earlier, so you’re contaminated.
: What was that I just heard in there?
: Mom! Go away! Seriously!
: Bye, Niki. I’ll see you tomorrow probably.
: Yeah, if I’m not grounded for the rest of my life...
I give her a hug goodbye before having to awkwardly walk past her mom who...of course decides to wink at me, as if being heard wasn’t already embarrassing enough.
When I make it down the stairs and head outside, there’s a car waiting for me.
This car feels like a second home. I’m in it almost every day. And the woman beside me is always the one driving.
But someday, I’ll be the one to drive her around. Which will be great since she always goes a little too fast.
: How was your day? Did you have fun with your friend?
: Yeah. We just watched movies and stuff.
: Liiiiiiiiiar. Your face is all red and you smell like you’re horny.
: That is...not a thing that someone can smell.
: Sure it is. You let out a certain scent when you’re turned on. I can always tell, Aki-kun.
: Stop being weird, please.
: Did she let you cum today?
: Come on, you can tell me. I promise I’ll only get a little jealous.
: I’m not telling you that.
: My poor baby! Blue-balled once more by his childhood friend! Oh, how it pains my fragile heart to see my little boy bullied in such cruel fashion!
: Hey, keep your eyes on the road! You’re bad enough at driving. The last thing I want is you trying it with your eyes closed.
: Sometimes, you can see more with your eyes closed, Aki-kun.
: Yeah, sure. Probably not when you’re driving a car, though.
: Yeah, probably not. But don’t worry, I’ll protect you. Defensive driving — commence.
: Where are we going anyway? We missed the turn to get to your place like five minutes ago.
: Somewhere special.
: Another one of those sketchy hotels?
: We can stop at one if you can’t hold it in any longer. I had somewhere else in mind, though.
: Somewhere else, like...where?
: You’ll see when we get there.
: Is...everything okay?
: Hm?
: You just...seem kind of tired.
: I’ve just been without you for so long that-
: Eyes on the road.
: I’ve just been without you for so long that the battery which powers my heart is dangerously low on energy.
: He hit you again, didn’t he?
: What did I tell you about asking questions you don’t want the answer to?
: I’ll kill him...
: I’ll be fine. You worry about yourself, okay?
: But I don’t care about myself. I care about-
: Akira, stop.
: I’m fine.
: But thank you.
: The fact you’re worried...means everything to me.
She keeps her eyes on the road from that point on...
But she doesn’t have to for long since we arrive at our destination not long after.
: The train station?
: Give me your hand.
: Why are we at the-
: Hand. Now.
I do as she asks and entangle my fingers with hers. They’re about the same size now — but it feels like only yesterday that hers made me feel so small.
: Same excuse as always if anyone asks?
: No one ever asks. No one ever will ask either. We probably just look like soulmates.
: Either that or they just assume you’re my age.
: It’s probably the other way around now, Aki-kun. You’ve grown so much. You’re practically a man now.
: Why are we here, Sekai?
: You’ve seemed off since you picked me up. And I can tell, you know. I’ve been watching you for years.
: I know you can tell, Aki-kun.
: I want you to be able to tell.
: But today, I’d like it a little more if you can just follow me to the edge of the universe.
: ...What?
: You heard me.
: Yeah, but you’re being all cryptic again and I never know what you’re trying to say when you do that.
: Aren’t you tired of this place, Aki-kun?
: Don’t you ever want to just...go somewhere else?
: Somewhere far...far away from here?...
: We’re not...jumping in front of this train, are we?
: Of course not...
: We’re just running away together.
: To Kyoto.
: Kyoto?
: I have friends there. One of them will give us a place to stay. I’m sure of it.
: You have friends everywhere, Sekai. I have no idea how you do it.
: You’ll come, right?...
: Won’t you, Aki-kun?...
: Sekai...
: Please tell me you’ll come...
: Please...I need you.
: What’s going on with you?...Seriously...
: Don’t ask questions you-
: If you want me to even consider coming, you need to talk to me. Otherwise I’m going to think this is just another one of your episodes.
: I’m scared, Akira.

: I keep...hearing things. Things that...confuse the fuck out of me. And they’re getting angrier and scarier and driving me up a wall and the only time I get any amount of silence anymore is when I’m with you.
: Which is why we need to get away. And in a couple years, we can make this official and...buy a house. With a garden. Be free.
: But here, I...
: Here that’s...not possible.
: Sure it is...You can dump him any time you want. But we can’t just leave. Niki’s here and-
: Akira, I’m pregnant.
: You’re...what?
: Don’t make me say it again. It was hard enough the first time.
: The...train is going to be here soon.

Sekai springs out of her seat so quickly that I worry she’s about to dive right onto the tracks. But I’m too dumbfounded to try and make use of our interlocked fingers to pull her back to both reality and me.
: What do you mean you’re pregnant?
: Aki-kun, the train-
: Fuck the train! What do you mean?!
: I’ll tell you more in Kyoto, okay?! You’re coming, right?!
: Not if you’re carrying that fucking asshole’s child, I’m not!
: I have a...I have a life here! And Niki...I can’t just leave her! You think we can just run away and make this work?! How?! Are you out of your mind?!
: Akira, don’t yell. People are going to-
: I don’t care! I don’t care if anyone’s suspicious! I don’t care if anyone thinks I’m being dramatic! I don’t care if anyone knows I love you!
: I love you too, Akira! Which is exactly why I’m going to-
: I don’t care what your plan is! For years I have watched you do the wrong thing and admired you anyway! But there’s someone else who loves me now too! It’s not just you anymore!
: And even if...even if I do love you...I can’t just leave her behind and run away with you on a whim! That’s not how adults are meant to deal with their problems, is it?! Is it?!
: Aki-kun...that’s enough.
: Enough?!
: Enough!
: You’re right.
: I’m being crazy.
: This was a dumb idea.
: I’m sorry for springing it on you out of nowhere.
: I’ll stay right here, okay?...
: That still doesn’t fix this, though...
: How could you?...
: What’s going to happen now?...
: I have no idea...
: But whatever does happen...you’ll stay with me, right?
: I feel like that’s what I should be asking you...
: Then ask me.
: Ask me, Aki-kun.
: Anything you’re unsure of...anything you’re afraid of...just tell me...
: And I will strangle those worries ‘til they’re blue in the face.
: Just ask me...
: Anything at all...
: Will you...
: Will you really never leave me?
: I don’t think I’d be able to if I tried.
: We’re gathered here today to bid farewell to Sekai and Nozomu Arakawa. May God look favorably upon their souls as they depart this mortal realm in search of something greater.
: Oh, right. The Four Orbs of Power.
